name: Alaska Price
source:
Alaska is a very intense person, she gets into heated arguments often, she either hates or likes with little in between. Her time with us is mostly spent talking about boys. She is very different from me, but we still manage to stay close.

[From Idril's Phone Contacts In-Game]
